g.text: Supervision was started for this process when the component
nothing is reported, the next cycle is checked
The process identifier and the timestamp of the failure are
reported. The supervision thread never touches the graph and
notify the component of the supervision failure
The component is already deactivated, or currently being
deactivated or re-activated: the failure is ignored.
[component was restarted after the failure timestamp]
The failure belongs to a previous run of the process:
The termination is already being reported through the
OsHandler thread: the failure is ignored.
[the failure belongs to the running process]
The killed process is detected by the OsHandler thread and reported
as an unexpected termination. The graph leaves the active Run Target
and the main loop starts a transition to the fallback Run Target -
The reaction to a supervision failure is to kill the process. The recovery
itself is the same as for any other unexpected process termination.
